dashboards_data.name: Docker AI Governance - Policy and Risk
dashboards_data.description: Docker AI Governance audit activity: policy decisions, composite risk scores, secret detections, approval round-trips and enforcement coverage across Docker Sandbox and the MCP Enterprise Gateway.

data.phrase:
dataset = issues
| filter xdm.issue.name contains "Docker AI Gov"
| comp count() as Issues
| view graph type = single xaxis = Issues yaxis = Issues

dataset = issues
| filter xdm.issue.name contains "Docker AI Gov"
| filter xdm.issue.platform_severity = "HIGH"
| comp count() as High_Severity
| view graph type = single xaxis = High_Severity yaxis = High_Severity

dataset = issues
| filter xdm.issue.name contains "Docker AI Gov"
| comp count() as Issues by xdm.issue.name
| sort desc Issues
| view graph type = column subtype = stacked layout = horizontal xaxis = xdm.issue.name yaxis = Issues

dataset = issues
| filter xdm.issue.name contains "Docker AI Gov"
| comp count() as Issues by xdm.issue.platform_severity
| sort desc Issues
| view graph type = pie subtype = full xaxis = xdm.issue.platform_severity yaxis = Issues legend_percentage = `true`

dataset = issues
| filter xdm.issue.name contains "Docker AI Gov"
| fields _time, xdm.issue.name, xdm.issue.platform_severity,
    xdm.issue.platform_status.progress, xdm.issue.assigned_to_pretty
| sort desc _time
| limit 25

dataset = issues
| filter xdm.issue.name contains "Docker AI Gov"
| bin _time span = 1h
| comp count() as Issues by _time, xdm.issue.name
| sort asc _time
| view graph type = line xaxis = _time yaxis = Issues series = xdm.issue.name

dataset = docker_ai_gov_raw
| filter decision in ($decision)
| filter agent in ($agent)
| filter username in ($username)
| filter category = "AUDIT_CATEGORY_EVALUATION"
| comp count() as Decisions by decision
| sort desc Decisions
| view graph type = pie subtype = full xaxis = decision yaxis = Decisions legend_percentage = `true` valuecolor("AUDIT_DECISION_DENY","#e33f3f") valuecolor("AUDIT_DECISION_APPROVAL_DENY","#9d2222") valuecolor("AUDIT_DECISION_APPROVAL_TIMEOUT","#ff6300") valuecolor("AUDIT_DECISION_APPROVAL_REQUIRED","#f7b500") valuecolor("AUDIT_DECISION_ALLOW","#00cf7f") valuecolor("AUDIT_DECISION_APPROVAL_ALLOW","#01e1ec")

dataset = docker_ai_gov_raw
| filter decision in ($decision)
| filter agent in ($agent)
| filter username in ($username)
| filter action_type != null
| alter surface = if(
    action_type in ("network_egress", "network_egress_execution"), "network",
    action_type in ("filesystem_mount", "filesystem_mount_execution"), "filesystem",
    action_type = "session", "lifecycle",
    action_type)
| comp count() as Events by surface
| sort desc Events
| view graph type = pie subtype = full xaxis = surface yaxis = Events legend_percentage = `true`

dataset = docker_ai_gov_raw
| filter decision in ($decision)
| filter agent in ($agent)
| filter username in ($username)
| filter decision = "AUDIT_DECISION_DENY"
| comp count() as Denials by resource_id, action_type
| sort desc Denials
| limit 15

dataset = docker_ai_gov_raw
| filter decision in ($decision)
| filter agent in ($agent)
| filter username in ($username)
| filter action_type = "network_egress"
| alter dest_port = arrayindex(regextract(to_string(resource_id), ":(\d+)$"), 0)
| comp count() as Attempts by resource_id, dest_port, decision
| sort desc Attempts
| limit 20

dataset = docker_ai_gov_raw
| filter decision in ($decision)
| filter agent in ($agent)
| filter username in ($username)
| filter agent != null
| comp count() as Events, count_distinct(username) as Users, count_distinct(audit_session_id) as Sessions by agent
| sort desc Events
| view graph type = column subtype = stacked xaxis = agent yaxis = Events

dataset = docker_ai_gov_raw
| filter decision in ($decision)
| filter agent in ($agent)
| filter username in ($username)
| comp count() as Events, count_distinct(username) as Users by client_name
| sort desc Events
| view graph type = column subtype = stacked xaxis = client_name yaxis = Events

dataset = docker_ai_gov_raw
| filter decision in ($decision)
| filter agent in ($agent)
| filter username in ($username)
| filter username != null
| alter denied = if(decision = "AUDIT_DECISION_DENY", 1, 0)
| comp count() as Events, count_distinct(agent) as Agents,
    count_distinct(audit_session_id) as Sessions,
    sum(denied) as Denials by username
| sort desc Events
| limit 15

dataset = docker_ai_gov_raw
| filter decision in ($decision)
| filter agent in ($agent)
| filter username in ($username)
| filter username != null and resource_id != null
| comp count() as Attempts by username, agent, action_type, resource_id, decision
| sort desc Attempts
| limit 30

dataset = docker_ai_gov_raw
| filter decision in ($decision)
| filter agent in ($agent)
| filter username in ($username)
| filter category = "AUDIT_CATEGORY_EVALUATION"
| alter denied = if(decision = "AUDIT_DECISION_DENY", 1, 0)
| comp count() as Decisions, sum(denied) as Denials by audit_session_id, username, agent
| sort desc Decisions
| limit 15

input_dict.xql: dataset = docker_ai_gov_raw | filter decision != null | comp count() as n by decision | sort desc n | fields decision | limit 50
dataset = docker_ai_gov_raw | filter agent != null | comp count() as n by agent | sort desc n | fields agent | limit 50
dataset = docker_ai_gov_raw | filter username != null | comp count() as n by username | sort desc n | fields username | limit 50

widgets_data.title: Issues Raised by Docker Governance Rules
widgets_data.description: Total security issues our correlation rules have raised in Cortex. This is the governance data converted into actionable detections.

data.phrase:
dataset = issues
| filter xdm.issue.name contains "Docker AI Gov"
| comp count() as Issues
| view graph type = single xaxis = Issues yaxis = Issues

widgets_data.title: High Severity Governance Issues
widgets_data.description: Issues raised at HIGH severity - currently the cloud metadata endpoint detection, which indicates possible cloud credential exposure.

data.phrase:
dataset = issues
| filter xdm.issue.name contains "Docker AI Gov"
| filter xdm.issue.platform_severity = "HIGH"
| comp count() as High_Severity
| view graph type = single xaxis = High_Severity yaxis = High_Severity

widgets_data.title: Issues per Correlation Rule
widgets_data.description: Detection volume per rule. Shows which governance rules are actually producing signal.

data.phrase:
dataset = issues
| filter xdm.issue.name contains "Docker AI Gov"
| comp count() as Issues by xdm.issue.name
| sort desc Issues
| view graph type = column subtype = stacked layout = horizontal xaxis = xdm.issue.name yaxis = Issues

widgets_data.title: Docker Governance Issues by Severity
widgets_data.description: Security issues raised in Cortex by the Docker AI Governance correlation rules, by platform severity.

data.phrase:
dataset = issues
| filter xdm.issue.name contains "Docker AI Gov"
| comp count() as Issues by xdm.issue.platform_severity
| sort desc Issues
| view graph type = pie subtype = full xaxis = xdm.issue.platform_severity yaxis = Issues legend_percentage = `true`

widgets_data.title: Open Docker Governance Issues
widgets_data.description: Individual detections raised by the Docker AI Governance rules, newest first.

data.phrase:
dataset = issues
| filter xdm.issue.name contains "Docker AI Gov"
| fields _time, xdm.issue.name, xdm.issue.platform_severity,
    xdm.issue.platform_status.progress, xdm.issue.assigned_to_pretty
| sort desc _time
| limit 25

widgets_data.title: Docker Governance Issues Over Time
widgets_data.description: Detections per hour. A cluster means an agent repeatedly crossing a policy boundary rather than a one-off. Given full width so the load curve is readable.

data.phrase:
dataset = issues
| filter xdm.issue.name contains "Docker AI Gov"
| bin _time span = 1h
| comp count() as Issues by _time, xdm.issue.name
| sort asc _time
| view graph type = line xaxis = _time yaxis = Issues series = xdm.issue.name

widgets_data.title: Governance Decisions
widgets_data.description: Every policy verdict over 24h. Denials and approval outcomes are the ones worth watching; allow is the baseline.

data.phrase:
dataset = docker_ai_gov_raw
| filter decision in ($decision)
| filter agent in ($agent)
| filter username in ($username)
| filter category = "AUDIT_CATEGORY_EVALUATION"
| comp count() as Decisions by decision
| sort desc Decisions

widgets_data.title: Agents in Use

widgets_data.title: Client Coverage
widgets_data.description: Sandbox versus MCP Enterprise Gateway versus cloud PEP. Record counts are a lower bound - audit emission depends on version, licensing and enforced org governance.

| sort desc Events
| view graph type = column subtype = stacked xaxis = client_name yaxis = Events

widgets_data.title: Top 15 Users
widgets_data.description: Busiest users under governance, with how many distinct agents each runs and how many actions policy blocked. Pick one in the User filter to narrow the whole dashboard to that person.

data.phrase:
dataset = docker_ai_gov_raw
| filter decision in ($decision)
| filter agent in ($agent)
| filter username in ($username)
| filter username != null
| alter denied = if(decision = "AUDIT_DECISION_DENY", 1, 0)
| comp count() as Events, count_distinct(agent) as Agents,
    count_distinct(audit_session_id) as Sessions,
    sum(denied) as Denials by username
| sort desc Events
| limit 15

widgets_data.title: User Activity Detail
widgets_data.description: What each user's agents are actually reaching. Most useful with a single user selected in the User filter - it becomes that person's full activity profile.

| comp count() as Attempts by username, agent, action_type, resource_id, decision
| sort desc Attempts
| limit 30

widgets_data.title: Busiest Governance Sessions
widgets_data.description: Sessions ranked by decision volume, with denial counts. High denial ratios are the sessions to review first.
